meta.what: Coal unit decommissioning years for the IRP-timing sensitivity (TODO 14cr): a unit listed here is gone from the start of the year given; every unit not listed keeps c4's date (UC_FLEET).
meta.basis: IRP 2025 (gazetted 28 Oct 2025): Camden, Hendrina, Grootvlei and Arnot retired by the financial year 2030 (plan p.40, gazette p.51), taken as gone from the start of 2030; no top-up to the plan's 8 GW (plan p.13). Kendal, Majuba, Lethabo, Matimba and Tutuka at 50-year end of life (plan p.24, section 3.2.1.1.3) from unit start years + 50; the plan gives no per-station years. Units mapped to the fleet file's half-station groups in unit order (units 1-3 to *, 4-6 to **). User decisions, 12 Oct 2026.
meta.source_start_years: Global Energy Monitor, Global Coal Plant Tracker, unit tables on gem.wiki (Tutuka, Lethabo, Matimba, Kendal, Majuba power station pages), read 12 Oct 2026
